tei:div.tei:p: gter mdzod/ (dza)pa la/ 'jam dpal shin tu khros pa nā ga rak+sha'i skor la/ nyang gter rtsa ba ldeb/ 3 1-5 rin chen gling pa'i gter gzhung ldeb/ 48 7-101 khyung 'khor ldeb/ 1 103-104 rgyun khyer smin gling gsung ldeb/ 1 105-106 sgrub thabs tshe nor gsung ldeb/ 6 107-118 zhal shes ldeb/ 1 119-120 gnam chos nā ga rak+sha'i skor ldeb/ 5 121-130 skyid grong thugs rdor gter ma nā ga rak+sha'i gsang sgrub ldeb/ 14 131-158 dmar khrid ldeb/ 5 159-167 dbang chog ldeb/ 12 169-192 ༈ pad+ma gsung zhi sgrub las/ tshe dpag med kyi skor la/ nyang gter mtsho skyes rdo rje'i phrin las dbang chog dang bcas pa ldeb/ 26 193-243 byang gter tshe sgrub lcags sdong ma gter gzhung ldeb/ 11 245-265 lcags sdong lha mang gi dbang chog rgyun khyer bcas sa skya pa kun bkra'i gsung ldeb/ 13 267-292 rang shar tshe lha yongs rdzogs gter gzhung ldeb/ 8 293-308 de'i phrin las dang dbang chog ldeb/ 13 309-333 sangs gling tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor dbang chog bcas chags med gsung ldeb/ 23 335-379 rdor gling zhi khro'i tshe sgrub 'od zer drwa ba'i las byang ldeb/ 15 381-410 dbang chog ldeb/ 11 411-432 rat+na'i tshe khrid rdo rje phreng ba gter gzhung ldeb/ 32 433-496 brgyud 'debs ldeb/ 1 497-498 phrin las dbang chog dang bcas pa la ldeb/ 16 499-531 gter kha bzhi 'dus tshe sgrub bdud rtsi bum chung chog bsgrigs ldeb/ 7 533-545 ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po'i tshe dbang mda' 'phel ma'i skor la ldeb/ 23 547-592 mnga' ris paṇa chen gter byon tshe sgrub ye shes 'od mchog gter gzhung ldeb/ 41 593-674 gsang sgrub phrin las ldeb/ 22 675-718 dbang chog ldeb/ 12 719-741 'bri gung dgongs pa yang zab kyi tshe skor gter gzhung dang*/ phyi sgrub ngag 'don dbang bcas rig 'dzin chos grags mdzad pa la/ 19 743-780 zab dbang cho ga ldeb/ 10 781-799
